segments.tha-ap549:3.3: Samāpattī tathā aṭṭha, tisso vijjā pavacchati.
segments.tha-ap549:4.3: Deti kassaci nātho so, catasso paṭisambhidā.
segments.tha-ap549:5.1: “Bodhaneyyaṃ pajaṃ disvā, asaṅkheyyampi yojanaṃ [asaṅkheyyepi yojane sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.tha-ap549:8.3: Addasaṃ varadaṃ [vadataṃ (sī. pī.), pavaraṃ (syā.)] seṭṭhaṃ, mahājanapurakkhataṃ.
segments.tha-ap549:9.3: Upetvā tassa kalyāṇaṃ, sutvāna vimalaṃ ahaṃ [vākyāni, sutvāna vimalānahaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap549:10.3: Nāddasaṃ tassa munino, tato pabbajito ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap549:13.3: Karuṇāya na nibbāyi, tato kāruṇiko muni.
segments.tha-ap549:16.1: “Yo sabbalokassa garu, loko [loke (syā. ka.)] yassa tathā garu;
segments.tha-ap549:17.3: Yāvajīvaṃ karitvāna, gato saggaṃ tato cuto.
segments.tha-ap549:19.1: “Devaloke mahārajjaṃ, pādesiṃ kañcanagghiyaṃ [dibbānubhojahaṃ tadā (syā.), rajjaṃ pādesi kaṃcayaṃ (sī.)];
segments.tha-ap549:20.3: Aññaṃ gatiṃ na jānāmi, kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap549:21.3: Nīce kule na jāyāmi, kittanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap549:27.3: Na gacchi kappāni apāyabhūmiṃ, sataṃ sahassāni balena tassa.
segments.tha-ap549:29.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap549:31.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā abhayo thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: So arahattaṃ patvā attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttaro nāma jinotiādimāha.
